name: tg-mentions
description: CLI tool to list active Telegram forum topics where you have been mentioned, sorted by creation date with direct t.me links.
author: Gabriel Rangel de Abreu

scripts.verify:tdlib: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs => { const { getTdjson } = await import('prebuilt-tdlib'); const crypto = await import('node:crypto'); const p = getTdjson(); console.log(p, crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest('hex')); })"
